record.what_it_does: Coda is an all-in-one doc/spreadsheet workspace app, and its REST API lets external programs read and write docs, pages, tables, rows, columns, formulas, controls, permissions, and trigger automations.
record.auth_notes: The public REST API (coda.io/apis/v1) is authenticated only with a personal API token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, generated per-user in Account Settings. Coda's OAuth2 support exists only inside the separate Packs SDK (for Packs to authenticate to *other* third-party APIs), not for third parties calling Coda's own API, so it is not usable as a multi-user agent auth flow against Coda itself.
record.access_notes: Any Coda user, on free or paid workspaces, can generate an API token immediately at no cost from Account Settings; no approval or paid plan is required to get working credentials, though what the token can do is scoped by the token owner's role/permissions in each workspace.
